# Choose a storage scope

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Choose storage by lifetime, sharing and permissions, then define read, write and failure ownership.

[Documentation home](../INDEX.md) · [Storage hook index](../api/INDEX.md#references)

Choose storage by lifetime, sharing and permissions before selecting an API:

| Need | React API | Non-React option |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Browser persistence scoped to one component instance | [useSPFxLocalStorage](../api/hooks/storage/local-storage.md) | Host browser storage with caller-owned namespacing |
| Browser-session persistence scoped to one instance | [useSPFxSessionStorage](../api/hooks/storage/session-storage.md) | Host session storage with caller-owned namespacing |
| JSON files in the current user's OneDrive app root | [useSPFxOneDriveAppData](../api/hooks/storage/onedrive-app-data.md) | [OneDrive service](../api/services/onedrive-app-data.md) |
| Read tenant storage entities | [useSPFxTenantProperty](../api/hooks/storage/tenant-property.md) | [Tenant property service](../api/services/tenant-property.md) |
| Read/write settings shared through the tenant app catalog | [useSPFxTenantKeyValueStore](../api/hooks/storage/tenant-key-value-store.md) | [Tenant store service](../api/services/tenant-key-value-store.md) |
| Tenant defaults with optional site overrides and explicit write scope | [useSPFxConfigurationStore](../api/hooks/storage/configuration-store.md) | [Configuration service](../api/services/configuration-store.md) |
| Read/write settings shared by subsites in one site collection | [useSPFxSiteKeyValueStore](../api/hooks/storage/site-key-value-store.md) | [Site store service](../api/services/site-key-value-store.md) |

## Browser and remote storage

Browser storage is instance-namespaced and best effort. Its defaults, removal and storage-event behavior are documented separately for local and session storage. It is not a shared cross-component synchronization bus.

Remote hooks need a matching provider and the relevant authenticated client. OneDrive operations require the documented Graph scopes. Tenant data uses the tenant app catalog; site data uses `pageContext.site.absoluteUrl`, the collection root, rather than the current subsite. Actual SharePoint/Graph grants authorize requests; permission indicators do not grant write access.

## Plan reads, writes and failures

Site-store mount, reads and removal do not provision a list; save or explicit service setup can provision it. Hook read failures return their documented fallback and publish error state; write rejections must be caught. Standalone services reject failures. Follow each reference for lifecycle ownership, pagination, schema enforcement and conflict behavior rather than assuming that every storage API has the same error contract.

Generic TypeScript parameters do not validate remote data. New list-store writes preserve text values and full bigint precision using explicit stored metadata; dates and historical unmarked values retain documented read limitations. Read the [serialization contract](../api/helpers/tenant-value.md) before choosing a format. Tenant/site writes use observed ETags and expose stale-update conflicts; retry after reading current data rather than assuming wildcard overwrites. A plain tenant/site store has one scope. The configuration API selects a site override when present and otherwise a tenant default; it does not deep-merge stored values.

Use the [Graph and storage checklist](../development/sharepoint-validation/INDEX.md#permissions-denial-and-absence) and [site collection checklist](../development/sharepoint-validation/INDEX.md#storage-destinations-and-persistence) to record real-host behavior separately from local checks.

## Layered configuration

Choose the configuration hook/service when the same key can have tenant defaults and collection-specific overrides. Reads discover stores lazily without creating missing lists. Returned metadata identifies the winning scope; layered mode follows the documented fallback, while tenant/site mode restricts the target. Save and remove require an explicit scope, so a caller cannot accidentally write to whichever scope happened to satisfy a read. Removing an override reveals a tenant default on a later read; it does not delete that default.

Use the [configuration reference](../api/hooks/storage/configuration-store.md) for actual options, discovery, pending/error state, ownership and nullish-value behavior. Validate real grants and cross-instance visibility with the [configuration host checklist](../development/sharepoint-validation/INDEX.md#storage-destinations-and-persistence).

#### Read and validate an unknown StorageEntity

```ts
import type { SPHttpClient } from '@microsoft/sp-http';

import { createSPFxTenantPropertyService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
async function demonstrate(context: { spHttpClient: SPHttpClient }, catalogUrl: string) {
  const service = createSPFxTenantPropertyService(context.spHttpClient);
  const property = await service.get<unknown>('my-app:featureEnabled', catalogUrl);
  if (typeof property.value === 'boolean') console.log(property.value);
}
```

#### Read and conditionally save at collection root

```ts
import type { SPHttpClient } from '@microsoft/sp-http';
import type { PageContext } from '@microsoft/sp-page-context';
import { createSPFxSiteKeyValueStoreService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
async function demonstrate(context: { spHttpClient: SPHttpClient; pageContext: PageContext }) {

  const store = createSPFxSiteKeyValueStoreService(context.spHttpClient);
  const rootUrl = context.pageContext.site.absoluteUrl;
  const setting = await store.get<boolean>('featureEnabled', rootUrl);

  }
}
```

#### Tenant default site override inventory and removal

```ts
import type { SPHttpClient } from '@microsoft/sp-http';
import type { PageContext } from '@microsoft/sp-page-context';

import { createSPFxConfigurationStoreService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
async function demonstrate(context: { spHttpClient: SPHttpClient; pageContext: PageContext }) {
  const store = createSPFxConfigurationStoreService(context.spHttpClient, {
    mode: 'layered',
    discoveryWebUrl: context.pageContext.web.absoluteUrl,
    siteCollectionUrl: context.pageContext.site.absoluteUrl,
  });
  await store.save('my-app:pageSize', 20, { scope: 'tenant' });
  await store.save('my-app:pageSize', 50, { scope: 'site', description: 'Local override' });
  const item = await store.get<number>('my-app:pageSize'); // value 50, source site
  const siteRows = await store.listScope('site'); // physical inventory, not effective merge
  await store.remove('my-app:pageSize', { scope: 'site' });
}
```

#### Edit local preferences

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxLocalStorage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

interface UserPreferences {
  theme: 'light' | 'dark';
  itemsPerPage: number;
  showSidebar: boolean;
}

function SettingsPanel() {
  const { value: preferences, setValue: setPreferences } = useSPFxLocalStorage<UserPreferences>(
    'userPrefs',
    { theme: 'light', itemsPerPage: 10, showSidebar: true }
  );

  const updateTheme = (theme: 'light' | 'dark') => {
    setPreferences(prev => ({ ...prev, theme }));
  };

  const updateItemsPerPage = (itemsPerPage: number) => {
    setPreferences(prev => ({ ...prev, itemsPerPage }));
  };

  return (
    <div className="settings">
      <label>
        Theme:
        <select
          value={preferences.theme}
          onChange={e => updateTheme(e.target.value === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light')}
        >
          <option value="light">Light</option>
          <option value="dark">Dark</option>
        </select>
      </label>

      <label>
        Items per page:
        <input
          type="number"
          value={preferences.itemsPerPage}
          onChange={e => updateItemsPerPage(Number(e.target.value))}
          min={5}
          max={50}
        />
      </label>
    </div>
  );
}
```

#### Keep and clear the last ten searches

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxLocalStorage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function SearchWithHistory() {
  const { value: history, setValue: setHistory } = useSPFxLocalStorage<string[]>('searchHistory', []);
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState('');

  const handleSearch = () => {
    if (query && !history.includes(query)) {
      setHistory(prev => [query, ...prev.slice(0, 9)]); // Keep last 10
    }
    // Perform search...
  };

  const clearHistory = () => setHistory([]);

  return (
    <div>
      <input
        value={query}
        onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Search..."
        list="search-history"
      />
      <datalist id="search-history">
        {history.map(term => (
          <option key={term} value={term} />
        ))}
      </datalist>
      <button onClick={handleSearch}>Search</button>
      <button onClick={clearHistory}>Clear History</button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

#### Save a session draft before clearing it

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxSessionStorage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

interface FormData {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  category: string;
}

function FormWithDraft({ save }: { save: (draft: FormData) => Promise<void> }) {
  const { value: draft, setValue: setDraft } = useSPFxSessionStorage<FormData>('formDraft', {
    title: '',
    description: '',
    category: ''
  });

  const handleChange = (field: keyof FormData, value: string) => {
    setDraft(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    await save(draft);
    setDraft({ title: '', description: '', category: '' }); // Clear draft
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={e => { e.preventDefault(); void handleSubmit().catch(console.error); }}>
      <input
        value={draft.title}
        onChange={e => handleChange('title', e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Title"
      />
      <textarea
        value={draft.description}
        onChange={e => handleChange('description', e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Description"
      />
      <button type="submit">Submit</button>
      <p className="hint">Draft auto-saved for this session</p>
    </form>
  );
}
```

#### Resume and complete a session wizard

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxSessionStorage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

interface WizardState {
  currentStep: number;
  completedSteps: number[];
  data: Record<string, unknown>;
}

function MultiStepWizard() {
  const { value: wizard, setValue: setWizard } = useSPFxSessionStorage<WizardState>('wizard', {
    currentStep: 0,
    completedSteps: [],
    data: {}
  });

  const goToStep = (step: number) => {
    setWizard(prev => ({ ...prev, currentStep: step }));
  };

  const completeStep = (stepData: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    setWizard(prev => ({
      currentStep: prev.currentStep + 1,
      completedSteps: [...prev.completedSteps, prev.currentStep],
      data: { ...prev.data, ...stepData }
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div className="wizard">
      <nav>
        {[0, 1, 2, 3].map(step => (
          <button
            key={step}
            onClick={() => goToStep(step)}
            disabled={!wizard.completedSteps.includes(step - 1) && step !== 0}
            className={wizard.currentStep === step ? 'active' : ''}
          >
            Step {step + 1}
          </button>
        ))}
      </nav>
      <main>
        <p>Current step: {wizard.currentStep + 1}</p>
        <button onClick={() => completeStep({ confirmed: true })}>Complete step</button>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

#### Read a site override then reveal its tenant default

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxConfigurationStore } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/hooks';
import type { SPFxConfigurationStoreItem } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/hooks';

function ConfigurationExample() {
  const store = useSPFxConfigurationStore({ mode: 'layered' });
  const [item, setItem] = React.useState<SPFxConfigurationStoreItem<number>>();
  const run = async (): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      await store.save('my-app:pageSize', 20, { scope: 'tenant' });
      await store.save('my-app:pageSize', 50, { scope: 'site' });
      setItem(await store.get<number>('my-app:pageSize')); // 50, source site
      await store.remove('my-app:pageSize', { scope: 'site' });
      setItem(await store.get<number>('my-app:pageSize')); // 20, source tenant
    } catch {
      setItem(undefined); // Render the current hook error below.
    }
  };
  return <>
    <button disabled={!store.isReady || store.isLoading || store.isWriting} onClick={run}>Run configuration example</button>
    <p>{item ? `${item.source}: ${item.value}` : 'No result'}</p>
    {(store.error ?? store.writeError) && <p role="alert">{(store.error ?? store.writeError)?.message}</p>}
  </>;
}
```

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxTenantKeyValueStore } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function TenantConfigEditor() {
  const { save, get, isReady, isWriting, error, writeError } = useSPFxTenantKeyValueStore();
  const [text, setText] = React.useState<string>('');
  const run = async (): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      await save('my-app:version', '123', 'Application version');
      const item = await get<unknown>('my-app:version');
      if (typeof item?.value === 'string') setText(item.value);
    } catch {
      // Write failures are rendered through writeError; reads use error + fallback.
    }
  };
  return <>
    <button disabled={!isReady || isWriting} onClick={run}>Save and read</button>
    <p>{text}</p>
    {(error ?? writeError) && <p role="alert">{(error ?? writeError)?.message}</p>}
  </>;
}
```

#### Read and save with separate hook errors

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxSiteKeyValueStore, SPFxSiteKeyValueStoreItem } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function SiteSettings() {
  const store = useSPFxSiteKeyValueStore();
  const [item, setItem] = React.useState<SPFxSiteKeyValueStoreItem<unknown>>();
  const [hasRead, setHasRead] = React.useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = React.useState('');

  const load = async () => {
    setHasRead(false);
    setMessage('');
    try {
      setItem(await store.get('toolkit-site-demo-setting'));
      setHasRead(true);
    } catch (failure) {
      setMessage(String(failure)); // For example, an operation before readiness.
    }
  };

  const save = async () => {
    setMessage('');
    try {
      await store.save('toolkit-site-demo-setting', { enabled: true }, 'Collection setting');
      setMessage('Saved');
    } catch (failure) {
      setMessage(String(failure));
    }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <button onClick={load} disabled={!store.isReady || store.isLoading}>Read</button>
      <button onClick={save} disabled={!store.isReady || !store.canWrite || store.isWriting}>Save</button>
      {store.error ? <p role="alert">{store.error.message}</p> :
        hasRead && !store.isLoading && <p>{item ? JSON.stringify(item.value) : 'Key not found'}</p>}
      {store.writeError && <p role="alert">{store.writeError.message}</p>}
      {message && <p>{message}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxOneDriveAppData } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
interface UserPrefs { favorites: string[]; notifications: boolean }
function UserPreferences() {

    {(prefs.error ?? prefs.writeError) && <p role="alert">{(prefs.error ?? prefs.writeError)?.message}</p>}
  </div>;
}
```

#### Add toggle and remove persisted todos

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxOneDriveAppData } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
interface TodoData { items: { id: string; text: string; done: boolean }[] }
function TodoApp() {
  const store = useSPFxOneDriveAppData<TodoData>('todos.json', {
    folder: 'todo-app', defaultValue: { items: [] }, createIfMissing: true,
  });
  const [text, setText] = React.useState('');
  const add = async () => { await store.write({ items: [...(store.data?.items ?? []), { id: crypto.randomUUID(), text, done: false }] }); };
  const toggle = async (id: string) => { await store.write({ items: (store.data?.items ?? []).map(item => item.id === id ? { ...item, done: !item.done } : item) }); };
  const remove = async (id: string) => { await store.write({ items: (store.data?.items ?? []).filter(item => item.id !== id) }); };
  return <div><input aria-label="New todo" value={text} onChange={event => setText(event.target.value)} />
    <button disabled={!store.isReady || store.isWriting} onClick={() => void add().catch(console.error)}>Add</button>
    <ul>{store.data?.items.map(item => <li key={item.id}>{item.text}
      <button disabled={store.isWriting} onClick={() => void toggle(item.id).catch(console.error)}>{item.done ? 'Reopen' : 'Complete'}</button>
      <button disabled={store.isWriting} onClick={() => void remove(item.id).catch(console.error)}>Delete</button>
    </li>)}</ul>
    {(store.error ?? store.writeError) && <p role="alert">{(store.error ?? store.writeError)?.message}</p>}
  </div>;
}
```

## Explicit Graph workflows and local reset

The two complete host scenarios below keep Graph initialization behind Start and business requests behind Run. They require the matching SPFx provider and approved endpoint grants. The photo requests the default 240x240 bytes and displays a 96px image or named fallback. OneDrive uses the fixed demo app-folder file, with no automatic fetch or missing-file provisioning; only its explicit Write replaces content. Its generic JSON type does not validate arbitrary stored shapes.

Reset preserves the operational child, original hook callbacks and genuine pending locks. It restores local drafts and hides stale publication; it does not clear hook state, cancel requests, revoke a still-owned photo URL or undo accepted OneDrive content. A current photo request may finish with a hidden owned URL after Reset, released by normal hook cleanup. Ordinary feature navigation can leave pending work, with unmount suppressing late UI publication. Real writes/cleanup require an authorized destination; metadata/download failures are not confirmed absence.

#### Read the current user photo with managed URL cleanup

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Avatar, Button, Image, Label, MessageBar, MessageBarBody, makeStyles } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { useSPFxMSGraphClient, useSPFxUserInfo, useSPFxUserPhoto } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

type DemoRegions = { controls?: React.ReactNode; commands?: React.ReactNode; status?: React.ReactNode; diagnostics?: React.ReactNode; children?: React.ReactNode };
type DemoProps = { render?: (regions: DemoRegions) => React.ReactElement; resetRevision?: number };
const useStyles = makeStyles({ profile: { display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '12px' } });
function ActivePhoto({ render, resetRevision = 0 }: DemoProps): React.ReactElement {
  const classes = useStyles();
  const user = useSPFxUserInfo();
  const graph = useSPFxMSGraphClient();
  const photo = useSPFxUserPhoto({ autoFetch: false });
  const live = React.useRef({ graph, photo });
  live.current = { graph, photo };
  const identity = React.useRef({ client: graph.client, reload: photo.reload, revision: resetRevision });
  if (identity.current.client !== graph.client || identity.current.reload !== photo.reload || identity.current.revision !== resetRevision) {
    identity.current = { client: graph.client, reload: photo.reload, revision: resetRevision };
  }
  const boundary = identity.current;
  const mounted = React.useRef(true);
  React.useEffect(() => { mounted.current = true; return () => { mounted.current = false; }; }, []);
  const sequence = React.useRef(0);
  const pending = React.useRef<{ reload: typeof photo.reload; request: number }>();
  const [executed, setExecuted] = React.useState<{ boundary: typeof boundary; request: number; completed: boolean }>();
  const run = React.useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
    if (!mounted.current || identity.current !== boundary || !live.current.graph.isReady || !live.current.graph.client || live.current.photo.isLoading || pending.current?.reload === boundary.reload) return;
    const request = ++sequence.current;
    pending.current = { reload: boundary.reload, request };
    setExecuted({ boundary, request, completed: false });
    try {
      await boundary.reload();
      if (mounted.current && identity.current === boundary && sequence.current === request) setExecuted({ boundary, request, completed: true });
    } finally {
      if (pending.current?.request === request) pending.current = undefined;
    }
  }, [boundary]);
  const current = executed?.boundary === boundary && executed.request === sequence.current && executed.completed;
  const error = current ? photo.error : undefined;
  const regions: DemoRegions = {
    commands: <><Button appearance="primary" disabled={!graph.isReady || !graph.client || photo.isLoading} onClick={() => { run().catch(() => undefined); }}>Run</Button></>,
    status: graph.initError ? <MessageBar intent="error"><MessageBarBody>{graph.initError.message}</MessageBarBody></MessageBar> : error ? <MessageBar intent="error"><MessageBarBody>{error.message}</MessageBarBody></MessageBar> : undefined,
    children: <>{!graph.isReady ? <Label>Microsoft Graph unavailable. Wait for client initialization.</Label> : photo.isLoading ? <Label>Loading...</Label> : <div className={classes.profile}>{current && photo.photoUrl ? <Image fit="cover" shape="circular" src={photo.photoUrl} alt={user.displayName} width={96} height={96} /> : <Avatar name={user.displayName} size={96} />}<Label>{user.displayName}</Label></div>}</>,
    diagnostics: <><dl><dt>Ready</dt><dd>{current ? String(photo.isReady) : 'Not requested'}</dd><dt>Blob</dt><dd>{current && photo.photoBlob ? `${photo.photoBlob.size} bytes` : 'Not requested'}</dd></dl><p>Reset hides local output and invalidates publication. It preserves the active hook, pending work and hook-owned URL; replacement, failure, target change and unmount release that URL.</p></>,
  };
  return render ? render(regions) : <>{regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}</>;
}
export function Demo({ render, resetRevision = 0 }: DemoProps = {}): React.ReactElement {
  const [started, setStarted] = React.useState(false);
  if (started) return <ActivePhoto render={render} resetRevision={resetRevision} />;
  const regions: DemoRegions = { commands: <><Button appearance="primary" onClick={() => setStarted(true)}>Start</Button></>, children: <p>Start initializes Microsoft Graph under the matching SPFx provider. Run then reads the current user's photo.</p> };
  return render ? render(regions) : <>{regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}</>;
}
export const demo = { host: 'webPart', kind: 'read', contentPlacement: 'configuration', observe: 'Start initializes Graph without a photo request; Run reads the current user at default 240x240, displays a 96px photo or named fallback, loading, error and blob bytes. Reset hides output while preserving the hook, pending work and owned URL until normal cleanup.' };
```

#### Read and explicitly replace OneDrive app data

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Accordion, AccordionHeader, AccordionItem, AccordionPanel, Button, Field, Input, Label, MessageBar, MessageBarBody, Select, makeStyles } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { useSPFxMSGraphClient, useSPFxOneDriveAppData } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

type DemoRegions = { controls?: React.ReactNode; commands?: React.ReactNode; status?: React.ReactNode; diagnostics?: React.ReactNode; children?: React.ReactNode };
type DemoProps = { render?: (regions: DemoRegions) => React.ReactElement; resetRevision?: number };
interface OneDriveDemoData { readonly message: string; readonly counter: number; readonly timestamp: number; }
const useStyles = makeStyles({ diagnostics: { minWidth: 0, maxWidth: '100%', overflowX: 'auto' }, json: { whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', overflowWrap: 'anywhere' } });
function ActiveOneDrive({ render, resetRevision = 0 }: DemoProps): React.ReactElement {
  const classes = useStyles();
  const options = React.useMemo(() => ({ autoFetch: false, createIfMissing: false, folder: 'spfx-react-toolkit-demo' }), []);
  const graph = useSPFxMSGraphClient();
  const appData = useSPFxOneDriveAppData<OneDriveDemoData>('test-data.json', options);
  const [operation, setOperation] = React.useState<'read' | 'write'>('read');
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState({ message: 'Project update', revision: 0 });
  const message = draft.message;
  const live = React.useRef({ graph, appData, message });
  live.current = { graph, appData, message };
  const identity = React.useRef({ client: graph.client, load: appData.load, write: appData.write, revision: resetRevision, operation, message, draftRevision: draft.revision });
  if (identity.current.client !== graph.client || identity.current.load !== appData.load || identity.current.write !== appData.write || identity.current.revision !== resetRevision || identity.current.operation !== operation || identity.current.draftRevision !== draft.revision) {
    identity.current = { client: graph.client, load: appData.load, write: appData.write, revision: resetRevision, operation, message, draftRevision: draft.revision };
  }
  const boundary = identity.current;
  const mounted = React.useRef(true);
  React.useEffect(() => { mounted.current = true; return () => { mounted.current = false; }; }, []);
  const sequence = React.useRef(0);
  const pending = React.useRef<{ load: typeof appData.load; write: typeof appData.write; request: number }>();
  const [executed, setExecuted] = React.useState<{ boundary: typeof boundary; request: number; completed: boolean; error?: Error }>();
  const observedRevision = React.useRef(resetRevision);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (observedRevision.current !== resetRevision) {
      observedRevision.current = resetRevision;
      setOperation('read'); setDraft(previous => ({ message: 'Project update', revision: previous.revision + 1 })); setExecuted(undefined);
    }
  }, [resetRevision]);
  const run = React.useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
    const active = live.current;
    if (!mounted.current || identity.current !== boundary || active.message !== boundary.message || !active.graph.isReady || !active.graph.client || active.appData.isLoading || active.appData.isWriting || (pending.current?.load === boundary.load && pending.current.write === boundary.write) || (boundary.operation === 'write' && boundary.message === '')) return;
    const request = ++sequence.current;
    pending.current = { load: boundary.load, write: boundary.write, request };
    const isCurrent = (): boolean => mounted.current && identity.current === boundary && sequence.current === request;
    setExecuted({ boundary, request, completed: false });
    try {
      if (boundary.operation === 'read') await boundary.load();
      else {
        await boundary.write({ message: boundary.message, counter: (active.appData.data?.counter ?? 0) + 1, timestamp: Date.now() });
      }
      if (isCurrent()) {
        // User edits retire the draft revision; this owned clear preserves its completed result.
        if (boundary.operation === 'write') setDraft(previous => ({ ...previous, message: '' }));
        setExecuted({ boundary, request, completed: true });
      }
    } catch (failure) {
      if (isCurrent()) setExecuted({ boundary, request, completed: true, error: failure instanceof Error ? failure : new Error(String(failure)) });
    } finally {
      if (pending.current?.request === request) pending.current = undefined;
    }
  }, [boundary]);
  const available = graph.isReady && graph.client !== undefined;
  const busy = appData.isLoading || appData.isWriting;
  const current = executed?.boundary === boundary && executed.request === sequence.current;
  const error = current ? executed?.error ?? (operation === 'read' ? appData.error : appData.writeError) : undefined;
  const completed = current && executed?.completed && !busy;
  // Legacy JSON null remains present; optional field reads do not validate stored shapes.
  const regions: DemoRegions = {
    controls: <><Field label="OneDrive operation"><Select aria-label="OneDrive operation" disabled={appData.isWriting} value={operation} onChange={(_, data) => { if (data.value === 'read' || data.value === 'write') setOperation(data.value); }}><option value="read">Read</option><option value="write">Write</option></Select></Field>{operation === 'write' && <Field label="Message"><Input aria-label="Message" disabled={appData.isWriting} value={message} onChange={(_, data) => setDraft(previous => ({ message: data.value, revision: previous.revision + 1 }))} /></Field>}</>,
    commands: <><Button appearance="primary" disabled={!available || busy || (operation === 'write' && message === '')} onClick={() => { run().catch(() => undefined); }}>Run</Button></>,
    status: graph.initError ? <MessageBar intent="error"><MessageBarBody>{graph.initError.message}</MessageBarBody></MessageBar> : error ? <MessageBar intent="error"><MessageBarBody>{error.message}</MessageBarBody></MessageBar> : undefined,
    children: !available ? <Label>Microsoft Graph unavailable. Wait for client initialization.</Label> : busy ? <Label>Loading...</Label> : !completed ? <Label>Run the selected operation.</Label> : error ? <Label>Operation not completed.</Label> : appData.isNotFound ? <Label>File not found.</Label> : appData.data === undefined ? <Label>No data returned.</Label> : <dl><dt>Saved message</dt><dd>{appData.data?.message === '' ? '(empty)' : appData.data?.message}</dd><dt>Counter</dt><dd>{appData.data ? String(appData.data.counter) : undefined}</dd></dl>,
    diagnostics: <><Label>approot:/spfx-react-toolkit-demo/test-data.json</Label><dl><dt>Ready</dt><dd>{completed ? String(appData.isReady) : 'Not requested'}</dd><dt>Not Found</dt><dd>{completed ? String(appData.isNotFound) : 'Not requested'}</dd></dl>{completed && !error && appData.data !== undefined && <Accordion collapsible className={classes.diagnostics}><AccordionItem value="data"><AccordionHeader>OneDrive data</AccordionHeader><AccordionPanel><pre className={classes.json}>{JSON.stringify(appData.data, undefined, 2)}</pre></AccordionPanel></AccordionItem></Accordion>}<MessageBar intent="info"><MessageBarBody>Reading a missing file does not create it. Only explicit Write replaces this file. Reset restores local drafts and hides publication; it preserves the active hook and genuine pending locks, does not cancel requests and cannot undo a remote write. Generic JSON types do not validate stored data.</MessageBarBody></MessageBar></>,
  };
  return render ? render(regions) : <>{regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}</>;
}
export function Demo({ render, resetRevision = 0 }: DemoProps = {}): React.ReactElement {
  const [started, setStarted] = React.useState(false);
  if (started) return <ActiveOneDrive render={render} resetRevision={resetRevision} />;
  const regions: DemoRegions = { commands: <><Button appearance="primary" onClick={() => setStarted(true)}>Start</Button></>, children: <p>Start initializes Microsoft Graph under the matching SPFx provider. Then choose Read or explicitly Write the fixed app-folder file.</p> };
  return render ? render(regions) : <>{regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}</>;
}
export const demo = { host: 'webPart', kind: 'write', contentPlacement: 'configuration', observe: 'Start initializes Graph without reading or writing. Read missing data never creates a file; explicit Write replaces the fixed app-folder message and increments its counter. Pending writes lock inputs. Reset restores local drafts and hides old publication while preserving the hook and real pending locks; it cannot undo remote writes.' };
```

## Stable browser names

Keep the instance ID and unscoped key stable to retrieve the same browser entry. [createScopedSPFxStorageKey](../api/helpers/storage.md#createscopedspfxstoragekey) creates a name such as `spfx:webpart-42:filters`; it does not encrypt data or synchronize components. The browser hooks own initialization, JSON conversion, storage events and best-effort writes. Local and session persistence have different lifetimes even when their APIs look similar.

A session draft should clear only after the caller's save succeeds. Wizard step completion, navigation eligibility and accumulated data are application state; the complete recipe above persists those choices and exposes the completion action. A local search history can deduplicate the current term, retain the last ten searches and clear deliberately, without implying a backend search or cross-instance bus.

## Historical helper encodings

The standalone [serializeTenantValue](../api/helpers/tenant-value.md#serializetenantvalue) and [deserializeTenantValue](../api/helpers/tenant-value.md#deserializetenantvalue) helpers preserve their historical JSON-first interpretation. New tenant/site list writers deliberately quote JSON-like text so `'123'` stays text. Do not pre-serialize with a legacy helper before passing a value to a new list writer. Existing raw records need no automatic migration, but previously lost numeric precision cannot be reconstructed. Date reads remain ISO text; bigint reads as exact decimal text. Use `unknown` and validate the application shape rather than treating a generic type as validation.

[escapeODataValue](../api/helpers/tenant-value.md#escapeodatavalue) escapes a string literal's quote content; it supplies neither surrounding quotes nor URL encoding. The combined source example keeps escaping, serialization, parsing and validation separate.

## StorageEntities and list stores

Choose [createSPFxTenantPropertyService](../api/services/tenant-property.md#createspfxtenantpropertyservice) to read existing StorageEntities, supplying the actual catalog URL. It does not discover that URL or add writes. Choose the tenant list store for application-managed shared settings. A current web URL is not an interchangeable catalog address, and a failed request is not evidence that a property is absent.

## Historical data and tenant-list conflicts

Both list stores preserve historical values while using explicit encoding for new writes. The tenant store preserves a legacy REST-null Note as legacy `null`; the site store maps a nullable empty Note to an empty string. Stored text `'null'` still reads as legacy `null`. This difference is an interoperability constraint, not a new absence default.

Provisioning/readiness is per service and normalized URL, while values and permission decisions remain operation-owned. SharePoint key equality follows its field/unique-column comparison, including case-insensitive matching while preserving returned casing. Failed uniqueness/schema validation must not delete data to make the store usable. See [Microsoft's unique-column comparison rules](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/office/developer/sharepoint-2010/ee536168%28v%3Doffice.14%29).

Observed ETags protect the service's snapshot-to-mutation interval. They do not protect a consumer's earlier `get`-to-`save` interval. Design editing conflicts accordingly: inspect current data before retrying, and do not interpret bounded creation-collision recovery as a transaction or blind overwrite. Missing/unsafe ETags and HTTP 412 remain failures. Catalog site-administrator status is not a tenant-store permission indicator or a substitute for actual list grants.

## Collection root and conditional mutations

Use `pageContext.site.absoluteUrl` for collection-wide settings shared across subsites. A current subsite has a different lifetime/scope from the collection root; user-specific data belongs in browser or OneDrive storage instead. Read and permission probes do not provision a list. Save or explicit setup may provision, requiring the actual schema-management rights in addition to item writes.

The complete service recipe reads a boolean, checks `canCurrentUserWrite`, then awaits save at the same root. Treat the indicator as UI guidance: actual SharePoint grants and item restrictions still decide the mutation. The React hook captures read failures in state and returns its documented fallback; the standalone service rejects. Distinguish an absent key from that fallback/error before telling a reader a setting does not exist.

## Layered whole-record configuration

A site record replaces the **whole** tenant record for its key. False, zero, empty text and legacy `null` remain present overrides; fallback occurs only for confirmed site absence. There is no JSON-property merge and a failed site read must not silently turn into a tenant default. Physical inventory identifies scope-local IDs and rows, rather than an effective merged list.

The complete service recipe writes a tenant default, writes a described site override, reads the winning record, lists physical site rows, then removes only that override. A later read can reveal the tenant default. Omitted descriptions preserve destination metadata; explicit empty text clears it. Select the mutation scope explicitly even in a single-store mode.

The hook takes mode-only configuration from its provider; the standalone service needs actual discovery-web/collection URLs. Discovery is lazy, and a layered site hit need not access the tenant catalog. This isolation is useful where site readers lack catalog rights. It does not add a background read, cross-store transaction, global cache or authorization layer. See [createSPFxConfigurationStoreService](../api/services/configuration-store.md#createspfxconfigurationstoreservice) and [useSPFxConfigurationStore](../api/hooks/storage/configuration-store.md#usespfxconfigurationstore) for their distinct operational contracts.

## Temporary browser download URLs

Browser reads follow [Microsoft's download guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/driveitem-get-content?view=graph-rest-1.0#downloading-files-in-javascript-apps): obtain complete Graph metadata, then immediately fetch the preauthenticated HTTPS download URL without Graph authorization headers or cookies. An authenticated `/content` redirect can fail browser CORS preflight. Do not project away the download annotation, retain its temporary URL, log it or forward credentials to the download host.

Only a recognized metadata not-found result is absence. An expired/failed download, including a download 404, remains failure. Treating it as absence could make a create-if-missing policy overwrite an existing file. The complete service example reads/isNotFound and replaces JSON; the hook examples separately exercise existing configuration, namespaced lazy reads, missing-file preferences and todo edits. Those examples require approved app-folder grants, JSON-compatible application data and real initialized clients; they do not create folders or validate arbitrary stored schemas.

## Picker references and storage

A saved picker reference is identity data, not a durable download token or a guaranteed current display model. Persist the complete accepted JSON array, including unresolved references, and resolve display separately. Do not replace it with the visible/resolved subset or save personal access tokens/history through a picker. See [reference selection](pickers.md#selecting-sharepoint-values) and the canonical picker contracts for source identity and stale-reference behavior.

#### Compose feature flags endpoint configuration and branding

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxTenantProperty } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
function TenantConfiguredWidget({ request }: { request: (endpoint: string, apiKey: string) => Promise<unknown> }) {
  const flags = useSPFxTenantProperty<{ enableNewUI?: boolean; enableBetaFeatures?: boolean }>('FeatureFlags');
  const endpoint = useSPFxTenantProperty<string>('CustomApiEndpoint');
  const apiKey = useSPFxTenantProperty<string>('CustomApiKey');
  const logo = useSPFxTenantProperty<string>('CompanyLogo');
  const theme = useSPFxTenantProperty<{ primary: string }>('CompanyTheme');
  const help = useSPFxTenantProperty<string>('HelpDeskUrl');
  const [result, setResult] = React.useState<unknown>();
  const [failure, setFailure] = React.useState('');
  const load = async () => {
    if (!endpoint.data || !apiKey.data) return;
    try { setFailure(''); setResult(await request(endpoint.data, apiKey.data)); }
    catch (error) { setFailure(String(error)); }
  };
  const error = flags.error ?? endpoint.error ?? apiKey.error ?? logo.error ?? theme.error ?? help.error;
  return <div>{error && <p role="alert">{error.message}</p>}
    {logo.data && <img src={logo.data} alt="Company logo" />}{help.data && <a href={help.data}>Help</a>}
    <p>Configured primary color: {theme.data?.primary ?? '#0078d4'}</p>
    {flags.data?.enableNewUI && <p>New UI enabled</p>}{flags.data?.enableBetaFeatures && <p>Beta features enabled</p>}
    {(!endpoint.data || !apiKey.data) && <p>Tenant properties not configured. Contact your administrator.</p>}
    <button disabled={endpoint.isLoading || apiKey.isLoading || !endpoint.data || !apiKey.data} onClick={() => void load()}>Call configured API</button>
    {failure && <p role="alert">{failure}</p>}<pre>{JSON.stringify(result, undefined, 2)}</pre>
  </div>;
}
```
